name: What is the first step in planning a home room addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the first step in planning a home room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Planning a room addition begins with clarifying your goals, assessing your property boundaries, and determining a realistic budget. Before hiring a designer or contractor, outline how the space will be used, note any structural constraints, and check local zoning requirements such as setback limits and lot coverage rules. As an owner-operated general contractor, HH Remodeling reviews your concept on site to evaluate how new framing will tie into existing rooflines and load-bearing walls. Gathering your property survey, HOA guidelines, and preferred layout ideas early helps streamline initial design consultations and prevents costly mid-project revisions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by defining the purpose of the space, checking property setbacks and HOA rules, and consulting a general contractor to assess your home's framing and layout.
